headline: Executive order creates a White House Faith Office, a new office inside the White House focused on matters of faith.
what_it_does: This order sets up a White House Faith Office. No summary was provided, so the exact duties, staff, and powers of the office are not described here. Based on the title alone, the office appears meant to handle faith-related matters for the White House.

who_it_affects.how: They may work with or be contacted by the new office, though the details are not given in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 7, 2025. The available material does not state a separate start date.
